_doc: Rockstar_ibot OpenClaw cron-COMMAND jobs (B2). COMMAND payloads run the same scheduler.js per-user functions as Railway and Inngest with zero model tokens. LIFE_RUN_LOOPS selects one scheduler owner during cutover. With the canonical Supabase schema configured, WAKE, TRAVEL, and ASK also use the atomic database claims from migrations/2026-06-24-ch1-atomic-dedup.sql as a second overlap fence. The scripts loop all lm_users rows. commandCwd is supplied at registration via LIFE_CALL_DIR. Requires OpenClaw with command-cron support.
